code:
.data 
str1: .asciiz "Five plus two is: "

.text
main:
    # Make room on the stack
    sub $sp, $sp, 4 

    # Load the values 5 and 2 and add them together
    li $t0, 5
    li $t1, 2
    add $t2, $t0, $t1

    # Store the result on the stack
    sw $t2, 0($sp)

    # Print the string at the address specified by str1
    li $v0, 4
    la $a0, str1
    syscall

    # Print the sum from the stack
    li $v0, 1
    lw $a0, 0($sp)
    syscall

    # Pop the stack back to the way we found it
    add $sp, $sp, 4

    # ... and quit!
    li $v0, 10
    syscall
description: Subtract 4 from $sp, store 5 + 2 at 0($sp), print a label string from .data, reload 0($sp) into $a0 to print the sum, and restore $sp.

Use syscall 4 to print `str1` (`"Five plus two is: "`), then load `0($sp)` into `$a0` with `lw $a0, 0($sp)` and print that integer with syscall 1.
Add 4 back to `$sp` on line 28 to restore `$sp`, then exit with syscall 10.
